why: Research question fully answered: the paper's ITL formula holds at low rates (R²>0.997 for rates 1-60) but breaks down at high rates due to batch size capping (R²=0.66-0.73 for rates 1-400); all directional predictions confirmed including a new TTFT crossover finding at rate≈250; seed robustness verified (CV<0.01%); root cause of breakdown identified (max_num_running_reqs=256 caps batch size, creating ITL ceiling vs M/G/1's predicted divergence).
